title: Data Engineer
description:
Your mission Bookboost is the Hospitality Engagement Platform that empowers hotels to understand and engage their guests like never before. We unify guest data, automate personalised communication, and deliver experiences that drive revenue, loyalty, and operational excellence.
 We have customers across more than 20 countries and a platform that wins on depth. As we scale, the volume and importance of our data is growing fast, and we're looking for a Data Engineer to build the infrastructure that keeps up.
 Your profile You'll design and build the data infrastructure that carries Bookboost from hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of guest data, moving, transforming and making it available to our frontend application and our machine learning and AI pipelines.
 This is a role with real scope. You'll work with the latest technologies on hospitality-industry-first use cases spanning both analytics and machine learning, and you'll have genuine ownership of how our data platform is designed rather than implementing someone else's blueprint.
 If you want to be handed narrow tickets and left alone, this is not that job. If you want to shape the data foundation the whole product runs on, it's a good one. What you'll own and deliver Scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, designed and built alongside Product and Engineering Data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and storage at high scale, deployed and monitored end to end Tools and abstractions on top of the data infrastructure for analytics, recommendations and machine learning Data orchestration and streaming pipelines Reusable data resources and design patterns, built in close collaboration with product teams What makes you a great fit? Data engineering depth: 4+ years of industry experience, with production systems you have owned rather than contributed to Programming and processing: strong engineering skills, ideally with distributed data processing (AWS, PySpark) Scale: strong quantitative skills and experienc…

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
About the role Data is undeniably one of the world's most valuable resources. However, it's futile if it's not in the right place or the right setup. We strive to place data where it's needed most and can be used to its fullest potential.
 Become a valued member of our data integration team and start your journey building scalable data architectures and fast data pipelines for our multinational clients. Our use cases range from data warehouse and lakehouse architecture implementations over IoT and data streaming setups to sophisticated AI scenarios, in industries ranging from manufacturing, consumer products, and healthcare to banking and insurance, just to name a few.
 Your responsibilities You will support the team in designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines according to client business needs and embedding them end-to-end into the given data stack
 On this role, you will assist in maintaining and optimizing data infrastructure required for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) from a wide variety of data sources
 As a junior Data Engineer, you will build, test, and deploy data artifacts on cloud platforms using modern version control best practices
 You will collaborate with senior engineers to ensure data accuracy, integrity, privacy, security, and compliance by applying data quality assurance methods
 Monitoring data pipeline performance and assisting in identifying opportunities for pipeline optimization
 In this role, you will work closely together with both reeeliance and client staff as part of an agile project team
 Our requirements Solid foundational knowledge of data modeling concepts and modern data warehousing architectures
 Proficiency in Python and strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating complex datasets
 Hands-on experience with Git for version control and collaborative development
 Practical exposure to or understanding of working within cloud environments (such as Azure or AWS)

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About Swap
 Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.
 Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.
 At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.
 Swap is entering a new data-driven era, and we need an Analytics Engineer to help us build for it.
 You'll join our Analytics Engineering team as a key contributor with real ownership. Your models will power the whole business, from the commercial insights Sales and Finance run on to the trusted data behind our customer-facing agentic systems. You'll help shape a modern, scalable data architecture, and you'll see your work used.
 We want a hands-on builder who wants to work in a high-quality dbt project and help set our analytics direction. If you like fast-moving, collaborative teams where your work counts, we'd love to hear from you.
 What you'll do
 Scale our dbt project, shaping its architecture and CI/CD so it keeps up with company-wide ambitions.
 Help define our data modelling strategy and maintain the core set of fast, scalable, and trusted models that everything downstream relies on, from our BI tool to our agentic systems and analytics APIs.
 Champion strong standards for data quality, PII governance, testing, and documentation, so our data stays reliable as we grow.
 Work with Sales, Finance, and Product to turn business questions into clear data requirements, and keep delivery expectations realistic.

New Work leben : Flexible Arbeitsorte, Workation in Europa und kultureller Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Spanien. Teamspirit : Arbeite mit Menschen, die motiviert sind, gemeinsam voranzukommen – und voneinander lernen wollen. Du gibst deinem AI-Agententeam die Richtung vor, verteilst Aufgaben, triffst Entscheidungen und verantwortest das Ergebnis. Dabei kombinierst du deine Expertise mit spezialisierten Agenten und entwickelst unsere Agenten und Workflows laufend weiter.

title: Fullstack Data Engineer
description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Engineering department is seeking a Full-stack Data Engineer with a focus on AI and NLP. You’ll design, implement, and maintain highly available data pipelines that support our core products.

In this role you will:

  • Use available technologies to develop medium to large features while proactively learning new ones and reducing technical debt.
  • Support colleagues to achieve overall team success and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Embody Nozomi Networks' Cultural Pillars and our mission to protect what matters most with transparency and trust.
  • Collaborate within an agile team that emphasizes automation and the creation of high-quality, well-designed software.
  • Take ownership of user-facing features from inception to release and beyond.

To be successful in this opportunity you will have:

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical skill.
  • Excellent problem-solving capabilities with a solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and concurrent programming.
  • Proficiency in a dynamic programming language such as Python or Ruby.
  • Knowledge of Machine Learning and NLP is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Docker and prior frontend development experience, including knowledge of JavaScript and React, is highly desirable.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer , you will join the Data Platform team. We are an enablement team: we build the tools, standards and foundations that let every engineering team at Swile own its data autonomously. You will work at the crossroads of data, software engineering and infrastructure, in a senior team where everyone has a direct impact.
 As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, your mission will be to:
 Design and improve the tools and platforms that empower engineering teams to build and run their own data pipelines
 Ship AI tooling (Skills, MCP) as part of the platform, to help teams design, build and run their data products
 Contribute to our batch processing (Airflow, dbt) and event-driven architecture (Kafka)
 Define, document and promote standards and best practices
 Help teams adopt our tools and practices, and grow their skills
 Evangelize the platform vision and build relays across teams, in France and Brazil
 ✨It will be a perfect match if you:
 Have solid experience in data engineering or platform engineering, with a good software engineering culture
 Have strong expertise in one area (data, infrastructure, software, EDA/streaming, developer tooling) and are curious to learn the others
 Have worked with some of these: Python, Ruby, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform
 Are autonomous, communicate clearly, and enjoy collaborating with and supporting other teams
 Are curious about new tools and practices, including AI (no expertise required)
 Speak good English (we work daily with our teams in Brazil)
 You are a future responsible swiler: you share our commitment to the environment, diversity, fairness and inclusion and are prepared to work ever…

title: Data Engineer, Product
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
As a Data Engineer on the Data Science & Analytics team, you'll build the foundation that lets analytics scale across Anthropic. You'll partner with Engineering, Product and other teams to turn raw data into reliable metrics, reporting and insights, and you'll make sure teams have accurate metrics for our consumer products from idea to launch. You'll also lead your own projects that make self-serve insights possible, so teams can make data-driven decisions.
 Responsibilities
 Understand, and where possible anticipate, the data needs of partner teams, and translate them into data models, reporting and technical requirements
 Define, build and manage key dbt pipelines that turn raw logs into canonical datasets
 Set data integrity standards and SLAs so data is delivered on time and accurately
 Build reliable dashboards that track core metrics and share insights across the company
 Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools that let self-serve analytics scale
 Partner with stakeholders to define and materialize metrics and analysis for new and evolving consumer products
 Shape Product teams' roadmaps from a data systems perspective
 Become an expert in our data models and data architecture
 You may be a good fit if you have
 Significant experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar Data Science & Analytics role, ideally partnering with Product leads to build and report on company-wide metrics
 A passion for Anthropic's mission of building helpful, honest and harmless AI
 Expertise building multi-step ETL jobs with tools like dbt, plus experience with workflow tools like Airflow and version control through Git…
